name: Consensus
summary: AI search across peer-reviewed literature: it reports what published studies found, not whether those studies are sound. Study quality and conflicting results still need your own judgment.
best_for: researchers, clinicians, students and writers who want evidence-backed answers drawn from peer-reviewed papers instead of the open web
skip_if: your questions are practical/commercial rather than research-based (a general AI assistant fits), or you need full systematic-review rigor (this accelerates it, not replaces it)
honest_knock: It searches peer-reviewed literature, which is its strength and its boundary: it can tell you what published studies found, not whether those studies are good. Study quality, sample sizes and conflicting results still need your judgment, and the AI summary layer can smooth over genuine scientific disagreement. Treat it as a dramatically faster literature scan, not an oracle; click through to the papers that matter.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, billed annually ($20 billed monthly)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 28 September 2026 in a rendered browser, monthly and annual tabs) Free: $0, 10 Pro messages and up to 3 Deep reviews a month. Pro: $20 a month billed monthly, or $12 a month billed annually ($144 a year), with unlimited Pro messages, 15 Deep reviews a month and 500 API and MCP uses included, then $0.05 a use up to 1,000. Deep: $65 monthly, or $45 a month billed annually ($540 a year), with 200 Deep reviews and 2,000 API and MCP uses, then $0.05 a use up to 10,000. Students and faculty with a school email and US healthcare professionals with an NPI number can get up to 40% off. Team and Enterprise carry no amount on the page; the vendor's machine-readable pricing file puts Team at up to 200 seats with 50 Deep searches per seat and Enterprise on contract, and it still gives Free 15 Pro messages where the rendered page says 10. The unit that matters is Deep reviews rather than seats. Correction: our earlier reading, which we could not confirm at the time, put Pro at about $15 a month or roughly $10 annually.
